mount_assumption: Envelope extends along left wrist local +X, from the current wrist STL's x=50mm end face. Local +Y is outboard in the robot neutral pose. This coarse mounting assumption is adjustable and not a measured flange transform.
shape_scope: One box covering the pictured open/closed endpoint dimensions and full adapter allowance, plus padding. Finger asymmetry is enclosed rather than individually modeled.
analysis_scope: Geometry only; original robot mass and inertia are unchanged.
